name: ai-chat
displayName: AI Chat (Azure OpenAI + App Service + Cosmos DB)
description: A chat API on App Service that calls an Azure OpenAI gpt-5-mini deployment and persists conversations in serverless Cosmos DB. All access is keyless via managed identity.
what: A chat API on App Service that calls an Azure OpenAI gpt-5-mini deployment and stores conversation history in serverless Cosmos DB. Access to both OpenAI and Cosmos is keyless via the app's managed identity (local auth disabled). Dev is cheap; prod is zone-redundant with higher model throughput.
why: Conversational AI is the most requested GenAI pattern. This wires the three pieces every chatbot needs - a model endpoint, a stateless app tier, and durable conversation storage - with keyless security and pay-per-use billing that matches spiky chat traffic.
potentialUseCases: A customer-support or internal helpdesk chatbot
A product/document Q&A assistant (extend with retrieval from the AI landing zone)
A copilot embedded in an existing web app
A GenAI prototype you harden to production with the prod profile

reliability: Zone-redundant App Service plan in prod
Cosmos DB serverless with Session consistency and automatic failover priority
Stateless app tier - conversation state lives in Cosmos
security: Keyless access: managed identity to Azure OpenAI and Cosmos (local auth disabled)
TLS 1.2 minimum across all tiers, HTTPS-only app
Custom subdomain on the OpenAI account for Entra token auth
costOptimization: Cosmos serverless - pay per request unit, ideal for spiky chat load
Pay-as-you-go token billing on the model deployment
Dev uses Basic app plan and low TPM capacity
operationalExcellence: Telemetry in Application Insights + Log Analytics
Model name/version and TPM capacity are parameters
performanceEfficiency: Provisioned TPM capacity tuned per environment
Premium v3 app compute in prod

quota.summary: Needs Azure OpenAI gpt-5-mini TPM capacity and App Service compute quota in the target region. Some subscriptions/regions have 0 App Service quota (e.g. East US on this lab subscription), which blocks the App Service plan at preflight.

requirements.detail: The model deployment requires tokens-per-minute (TPM) quota for gpt-5-mini in the region (10K TPM in dev). gpt-5-mini is offered on the GlobalStandard SKU, which is not available in every region.
The App Service plan needs available compute (vCPU) quota for the chosen SKU in the region. Premium v3 zone redundancy in prod requires capacity >= 3.

architecture.summary: Stateless chat API on App Service calls a keyless Azure OpenAI deployment and persists conversation history in serverless Cosmos DB, with telemetry to Application Insights.

components.name: Azure OpenAI gpt-5-mini input tokens
components.notes: Assumes ~20M input tokens/month on GlobalStandard. Meter naming varies - verify.

components.name: Azure OpenAI gpt-5-mini output tokens
components.notes: Assumes ~5M output tokens/month on GlobalStandard. Meter naming varies - verify.
